WHAT: Exercise difficulty gating means keyboard-input exercise types (Transform, Construct, SlotFill, HighlightReplace, IfThen) never appear in fresh-state sessions.
WHY: `ContentService` sets maxDifficulty = starLevel + 1. Fresh state = starLevel 0 = maxDifficulty 1. All keyboard exercises are authored at difficulty ≥ 2.
HOW TO REACH THEM: Set UserDefaults flag before launching:
  `xcrun simctl spawn booted defaults write com.nedas.negotiationtrainer forceMaxDifficulty -bool true`
  Then reinstall app via Maestro `clearState: true`.
GOTCHA: Maestro's `arguments` in flow config does NOT pass through to iOS UserDefaults — must use simctl directly before running the flow.
